keycloak-extensions-demo | at org.keycloak.services.resources.admin.info.ServerInfoAdminResource.setProviders(ServerInfoAdminResource.java:173) keycloak-extensions-demo | at org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.server.handlers.InvocationHandler.handle(InvocationHandler.java:29) keycloak-extensions-demo | at io.quarkus.resteasy.reactive.server.runtime.QuarkusResteasyReactiveRequestContext.invokeHandler(QuarkusResteasyReactiveRequestContext.java:141) keycloak-extensions-demo | at org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.common.core.AbstractResteasyReactiveContext.run(AbstractResteasyReactiveContext.java:147) keycloak-extensions-demo | at body:
libast: Fix sftable.c
    While skipping over indexed gap we create a dummy arg entry
    The original sez:  /* gap: pretend it's a 'd' pattern */
    It is not a good idea as it try to fetch an integer of width 0
    (the trick) but yet to access integer (then variables) over
    the skipped arags.
    Using 'c' instead of 'd' prevent this.
    As a bonus it allows the nuke of the fmt reuse via the idiom
    printf '%s %999$s\n' a b c d e f g h i j k

tests: Added printf.sh test to exhibit the bug is fixed.

body: Este PR añade una aplicación web que permite a los usuarios ingresar una cadena de texto y obtener su versión invertida. La implementación sigue buenas prácticas de desarrollo, aplicando principios como SRP (Single Responsibility Principle) y separando la lógica de la interfaz de usuario. ✨ Cambios Incluidos • Estructura modular: • index.html: Estructura de la interfaz de usuario. • styles.css: Estilos minimalistas y modernos. • script.js: Lógica de inversión de texto y manejo de eventos. • Validación de entrada: Manejo de errores cuando el input está vacío. • Experiencia de usuario mejorada: Feedback visual con mensajes de error en color rojo. • Función pura reverseString() que mantiene la lógica desacoplada. 🔍 Ejecución 1. Clonar el repositorio: `git clone https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/reverse-string.git` 2. Abrir index.html en el navegador. 3. Ingresar un texto y hacer clic en “Invertir” para ver el resultado. ✅ Consideraciones • Código limpio, bien documentado y modular. • Separación de responsabilidades aplicada correctamente. • Preparado para futuras mejoras, como animaciones o soporte multi-idioma. 🔗 Demo y Pruebas Se recomienda probar en diferentes navegadores para verificar compatibilidad.

* Added functions to generate SEO metadata for various pages, including `generateSEOMetadata` in `markket/metadata.ts`, and integrated these functions into multiple pages such as `app/[slug]/page.tsx`, `app/docs/[id]/page.tsx`, `app/page.tsx`, `app/store/[slug]/blog/[id]/page.tsx`, `app/store/[slug]/blog/page.tsx`, and `app/store/[slug]/page.tsx`. ([app/[slug]/page.tsxR11-R37](diffhunk://#diff-15b6ef6f25e71d012ef07cf98c566a5a214057ed1e4413960acc3845931fbda2R11-R37), [app/docs/[id]/page.tsxR9-R36](diffhunk://#diff-51cd88a39b7cc2a43123cc25a71b9db3b8a4a1f2a52d04d98a4bc7e2ca34f7b1R9-R36), [app/page.tsxL2-R27](diffhunk://#diff-6efdf509a785a0658b2e31a8c33d298de14321d9672179370e99cc76241c1eb0L2-R27), [app/store/[slug]/blog/[id]/page.tsxR4-R37](diffhunk://#diff-485b6708ce47d8220c44bc8bc93eb2973696c9cf28cae24d552875b0fdecf18eR4-R37), [app/store/[slug]/blog/page.tsxR7-R37](diffhunk://#diff-a3e22572a2ce8535d1d4b7820f91644f622f857198e7f4e214cf661888188a4dR7-R37), [app/store/[slug]/page.tsxR6-R34](diffhunk://#diff-a167422f634cc4eca2b9e3d45ba3cedd9f738722435970ad296ff4b9c6deb7d9R6-R34))

### UI Component Updates:
* Introduced `PageContent` component in `app/components/ui/page.content.tsx` to render page content using `BlocksRenderer`. This component is now used in multiple pages to display dynamic content. [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-1a9b6f9887eff6cfc2aa1b8f32a0b2fd369689744706a1769ab8d2e32e3fce80R1-R29) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-6efdf509a785a0658b2e31a8c33d298de14321d9672179370e99cc76241c1eb0R185-R192) [app/store/[slug]/page.tsxL79-R98](diffhunk://#diff-a167422f634cc4eca2b9e3d45ba3cedd9f738722435970ad296ff4b9c6deb7d9L79-R98))

[[1]](diffhunk://#diff-6efdf509a785a0658b2e31a8c33d298de14321d9672179370e99cc76241c1eb0L27-R51) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-6efdf509a785a0658b2e31a8c33d298de14321d9672179370e99cc76241c1eb0L36-R85) [[3]](diffhunk://#diff-6efdf509a785a0658b2e31a8c33d298de14321d9672179370e99cc76241c1eb0R98-R102)

### Style Enhancements:
* Added new styles in `app/styles/blocks.scss` to improve the appearance of content blocks, including headings, paragraphs, lists, links, blockquotes, code blocks, tables, and special callouts.

author: matibenavides
body:
Junto a la impementación CRUD funcional de la App Temperatura, se crea validaciones login para usuarios y registros de datos propios de los 'users'.

- **Autenticación de usuarios**: (_App Login_) maneja funciones "iniciosesion" , "muestramenu" y "cerrarsesion".
- **Registro de Usuarios**: (_App Login_) maneja formularios Django y función 'registroUsuario'.
- **Listado**: Función "mostrarListaTemperatura" muestra registros con búsqueda, paginación y opciones de acción.
- **Visualizar/Editar Datos**: Permite visualización y actualización mediante "visualizarTemperatura" y "actualizarTemperatura".
- **Eliminar Datos:** Función "eliminarTemperatura" para eliminar y confirmar/o mensaje de error.
- **Descargar PDF**: Usa Weasyprint para generar PDF, implemento de función "DescargarPDFTemperatura"

### Autenticación de Usuarios

- **Funciónes**
  - _iniciosesion_: Compara los inputs de inicio de sesión y contraseña, Si el usuario no es None, se crea el login() y se envia mensaje de "Bienevenido {username}". Caso contrario, señala un mensaje de que hubo un error y vuelve a inicio.
  - _muestramenu_: la petición pregunta si el usuario esta autenticado, para poder mostrar template menu.html. Caso contrario, volverá a inicio junto a mensaje de que debe iniciar sesión.
  - _cerrarsion_: Cierra la sesión al ser llamada la función mediante urls.

> Se Ajustan las funciones de: (_App Cloraciones_) | (_App Temperaturas_).
Para que contentan @loguin_required , redirigiendo cualquier intento a una url sin estar logeados de vuelta al 'Inicio' (login).

### Registro de Usuarios

- **Formularios**
  - _formularioRegistro(UserCreationForm)_: Maneja la toma de datos para registrar el usuario (formato default django)
  - _TrabajadorForm(forms.ModelForm)_: Agrega registros para la tabla 'Trabajador'
> Estos dos formularios se muestran juntos, para que cuando se quiera crear un usuario nuevo a la plataforma, de forma pareja, pueda agregar datos del trabajador personales. Mismos datos que seran mostrados en los registros de Datos.


### Listado de registros

- **Función: mostrarListaTemperatura**
  - Muestra registros de GrupoTemperatura con información clave (id, observación, fecha, linea, turno y trabajador) junto con botones de acción: Visualizar, Descargar PDF y Eliminar
  - Incluye búsqueda y paginación (10 registros por página).
> Se agrega envio de ids de Lineas por cada sector dentro del navbar.html. De esta manera al ingresar a 'Temperatura' desde la sección de la Linea 11, viajaras al template enviando el id referente a la Linea. Lo mismo si decides ingresar a 'Temperatura' desde otra sección que posea el template. Enviara su id en un campo hidden. (Este formato está integrado en la app cloracion y deberá integrarse en las futuras Apps).


### Visualización, actualización y eliminación

- **Funciones**
  - _visualizarTemperatura_: Al presionar "Visualizar, se muestran los detalles del registro relacionado con GrupoTemperatura y sus datos de Temperatura
  - _actualizarTemperatura_: Permite actualizar (llamando a 'actualizarTemperatura') que reescribe los datos recibidos de db.
  - _eliminarTemperatura_: Elimina el registro de GrupoTemperatura mediante .delete() y actualiza el listado, mostrando mensaje de confirmación. ( Este botón se implementa tanto en el listado visualmente, como en el registro seleccionado.


### Descarga de PDF

- **Función DescargarPDFTempteratura**
  - Utiliza Weasyprint y el template 'descargarpdfTemp.html' para generar un PDF limpio de los datos.
  - Incluye validaciones para manejar datos None (reemplazándolos por {-}) y errores en caso de un id inexistente
  - Como los datos son flotantes, todos los campos al estar vacios contendran el guión de ser posibles.

author: apocelipes
body:
We skip the JSON serialization and convert the data directly into Go code, which saves considerable startup time.

"scc --languages" is now 40% faster:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16e35f4d-654d-4953-8f66-799c845118e8)

Running on a small code base can gain 7% improvements and on big code bases it could be 1~3%:
![small](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/687f6fae-d2f2-4ce2-907a-8e01cd67c06c)

![big](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7fcc40cc-3e5e-4463-889a-a5e542550263)

Pros:
- Code changes are more readable
- Faster startup
- Human readable data (Go code is more readable than base64 encoded JSON)
- Save memory: Language data has a large number of repeating string constants, which can be optimized by the compiler.

Cons:
- It may be horrible to see a 12k lines code file, even it is generated by tools.
- To generate code, "scripts/include.go" uses a few tricks, such as copying the structure definitions from “processor/structs.go”, which makes the code not particularly elegant.
- The size of the binary file was increased by 200kb.
- There is a performance degradation when `languageDatabase` is not required, because now the language data will always be loaded at startup. For example `scc --help` is 10% slower than before. However, there are only very few scenarios that don't require language data.

If you prefer compressed JSON data, that's fine. This code generator is only my weekend DIY :)

# Implement Constant-Time Sum of First N Natural Numbers

## Original Task
Write a function that takes an integer n as input and returns the sum of all numbers from 1 to n in constant time.

## Summary of Changes
Added a constant-time function to calculate the sum of first n natural numbers using the arithmetic series formula n * (n + 1) / 2. Implemented robust input handling and created comprehensive test cases to verify the function's correctness across different input scenarios.

## Acceptance Criteria
All tests must pass. The function must calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to n using the arithmetic series formula. The function must handle both odd and even values of n. The time complexity must be O(1), regardless of the input value. The function must return the correct sum for any valid input.

## Tests
 - Verify sum calculation for small positive integers
 - Verify sum calculation for large positive integers
 - Ensure function handles edge case of n = 0
 - Confirm time complexity remains constant for different input sizes
 - Check function works correctly for both odd and even input values
 - Validate return type and precision of the sum calculation

author: totto16
body:
## Description

In #342 (https://github.com/oae/gnome-shell-pano/pull/342/commits/8829de89a47cc8814ed3431ef3abd4439e43531a and https://github.com/oae/gnome-shell-pano/pull/342/commits/8a99348a9244c167d12dfe65d7228e9e6d5ad33d) I updated some dependencies, that our locale generation script uses. The updates made them ESM only. I used node v22.14.0  and I didn't notice any problem. But after investigating a failure reported in #347 I found out, that that broke support for older node version than 22.12.0. The reason for this is the following timeline:

 
| node version | change | ref |
|:------:|:-----:|:-----:|
| v20.17.0 | `--experimental-require-module` flag added, default `false`  | [ref](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v20.x/api/cli.html#--experimental-require-module) |  
| v22.0.0 | `--experimental-require-module` flag added, default `false` | [ref](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/cli.html#--experimental-require-module) |  
| v22.12.0 | `--experimental-require-module` flag defaults to `true`  | [ref](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/cli.html#--experimental-require-module) | 

The flag `--experimental-require-module` makes `require()` calls also support ESM modules, which we need, if we want to use the newest versions of some dependencies.

This feature is under active development, but it's stable in the LTS branches of node

So to fix this issue, I added `NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-require-module'` in front of every ts-node call. I also guarded everything with an explicit `engines` field in the package.json. So we support only the node versions, where this feature can be enabled. I made the engines field strict, so that it can't be circumvented.

This shouldn't introduce problems, as we use node 22 in actions anyway, and we just use this to generate locales.

Fixes #347

body:
### Description of Changes

The SDK swizzles the following UIApplicationDelegate methods:

    UIApplicationDelegate.application(:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
    UIApplicationDelegate.application(:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
    UIApplicationDelegate.application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)

This PR addresses two issues:

1. Currently, while the SDK stores and calls the original implementation from the hosting app, it doesn't account for cases where these methods are already swizzled by other SDKs. This PR ensures proper method chaining by calling any previous implementation (whether it's the original or another SDK's swizzled version).

2. The existing implementation doesn't properly handle cases where the hosting app uses `UIApplicationDelegateAdaptor` (SwiftUI apps). This PR makes sure the original implementation is always called.

author: 4rneee
body:
Adds actions to the live notification on Linux. Because libnotify supports adding multiple actions the behavior is as follows:
The default action is selected in the settings page (same dialog as on Windows). We add the default action and the 3 actions as action. 

The behavior then depends on the notification client. Two examples: 
[The documentation for Dunst](https://dunst-project.org/documentation/#ACTIONS) says: 
>If there is exactly one associated action, or one is marked as default, that one is invoked. If there are multiple, the context menu is shown.

On Gnome the default actions is performed when clicking the notification and the other options are displayed as buttons when you hover over the notification.

Let me know if you like this approach or would rather only have one default option that is specified in the settings. 

Fixes #5937

Further notes:
- I decided against a text explaining the action ("Click to ...", like on Windows) because the behavior on how to invoke the action depends on the client.
- I am not sure if introducing `channelNameHeap` is the best way to pass the channel name to the `onAction` callback

This PR enhances the marker-api project by improving Celery's configuration, ensuring stable parallel processing, and adding an example endpoint for converting multiple PDFs using Celery workers.

Key Changes
Docker Compose Improvements 🐋

Added local time zone configuration in all volumes to avoid time shifting issues.
Celery Workers Configuration ⚙️

Configured heartbeats, timeouts, and worker limits to prevent timeouts during processing.
Parallel Processing Example 📄

Added a new endpoint celery_convert_multiple_pdfs to demonstrate how to implement parallel PDF conversion using Celery and marker-api.
